_comment: TIER 8, THE TOP OF THE LADDER AS IT STANDS. Automating collection outright is the biggest
single change in the mod, so it is what finishing the freight ladder buys.
The tier is PROVISIONAL (owner, 2026-09-06): the End dimension and later-game content are
still to come and the ladder is expected to grow past eight, so anything reasoning from
'tier 8 is the finale' is reasoning from a temporary fact.
DEARER THAN THE DEPOT because this is the half that does the work. A Depot with no Hauler is
a pad; a Hauler with no Depot has nowhere to dock. Pricing the machine above the pad means a
player who can afford only one buys the thing they cannot improvise.
